# Superseded Private Access Inputs

The pre-S12 private-access corpus is retired. Its fifty inputs and qualified expectations belonged
to the earlier type-qualifier/prefix/result-access model, and are preserved by the recorded Git
checkpoint, not retained as an alternate compiler mode. The
[checkpoint review](../../../../history/reviews/v2.0.0-first-access-slice.md) and
[contract snapshot](../../../../history/reviews/v2.0.0-access-checkpoint-contracts.md) preserve their
scope/evidence. They are not a source of new-language semantics.

The production private goal now consumes the
[value-binding corpus](../value-bindings/README.md) under its owning future grammar. No old corpus
inventory script, shape snapshot or parser/checker consumer remains at this path. Historical
commands in the earlier review describe that earlier checkout, not current verification.
